# Notice
This is a stripped down version of the [STM32CubeU5 MCU Firmware Package](https://github.com/STMicroelectronics/STM32CubeU5) to minimize the cloning size of this repository. It was generated using STM32CubeMX, version 6.16.1. This is an external project and all files (except for this notice) in this directory are licensed as per `LICENSE.md` or `LICENSE.txt` in each subdirectory.

Files in this directory correspond to the version supplied with STM32CubeMX, version 6.16.1.
